claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^112.75481607678738798885498216397133798838017589484899596113957855255626851493333+2^66) < 2^111.39793405685719716752823458066029348989431515505916086419386518505106315585915 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7202073246512176891, (K/2^64) x 0.998911 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.998911 and costs at most 2^121.902376992501 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
